article.story: BALTIMORE -- — Omar Croskey scored 18 points as South Carolina State beat Coppin State 85-77 on Monday night. Croskey also had three steals for the Bulldogs (8-9, 2-0 Mid-Eastern Athletic Conference). Michael Teal hit three 3-pointers and scored 14. Drayton Jones made 7 of 10 free throws, scoring 13. Jonathan Dunn finished with 16 points and six rebounds to pace the Eagles (2-14, 1-1). Toby Nnadozie had 15 points and four steals, while Khali Horton scored 14. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
